title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier Solid Brass Hardware | Lavender | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier | Allied Brass, Lavender
description:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf featuring three tiers and solid brass hardware for space-saving organization in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat. Part of the Carolina Collection, this shelf pairs transitional bathroom hardware styling with practical vertical storage.

Highlights:
- Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Thick, beveled-edge glass for a clean, finished look
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a streamlined appearance
- Coordinates with other pieces in the Carolina Collection

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Projection: 5.54 Inches
- Glass thickness: 0.38 Inch
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
